meta.expect: still today; does not play a later meeting

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have until then. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Start there.
You asked for this meeting, Hale, so I'm here. Your school's own procedure says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered. Why wasn't I?
[One week later. Owen has done the rewrite and got 78.]
It's still today, Hale. Nothing has been rewritten and nothing has been agreed. Why wasn't I called before that zero went in?
So, now that the rewrite is done, are you satisfied?
There is no rewrite, Hale, and I haven't agreed to one. Twice now you've talked past my question, and I'm writing that down. The zero comes off, or I go to the principal's office tonight.
[The principal walks in and sits down.]
Nobody else is in this room, Hale. If the principal wants to join us, I'd welcome it, because the next stop is that office anyway. What do you have besides a mark in a gradebook?
